outlook.statement: US market recovery anticipated in FY 2026-27

Global economic outlook remains cautiously optimistic but subject to significant downside risks; growth expected to stabilize over medium term depending on geopolitical conflicts, trade/tariff policies, energy market stability, and monetary policy normalization.
Worldwide IT spending projected to reach approximately USD 6.15 trillion in 2026 (10.8% growth over 2025); India IT spending projected to reach approximately USD 176.3 billion in 2026 (10.6% growth).
India's AI sector projected to reach US$20-22 billion by 2027 at CAGR of 30%; global AI spending expected to exceed USD 2 trillion in 2026.

Global public cloud services market projected to reach approximately USD 1.19 trillion by 2026 and exceed USD 2 trillion by 2030 (CAGR over 15%); India public cloud market projected to reach USD 30.4 billion by 2029 (CAGR 22.6%).
Global core banking solutions market estimated at USD 16-19 billion during 2024-2025, projected to grow at CAGR of 10%-19% reaching approximately USD 40-80 billion by 2030-2032.
India's banking sector assets under management projected to reach approximately USD 1.2 trillion by 2030 (CAGR ~14%); credit growth remains above 12%.
IT industry transitioning toward more stable, growth-oriented phase supported by sustained demand for digital transformation and efficiency-led investments.

The Company is well positioned to drive innovation, enhance resilience, and support long-term growth in a dynamic global environment by focusing on core service lines, deep expertise in banking and government sectors, and continued investments in next-generation capabilities.
The Company will continue to focus on strengthening technical capabilities, enhancing workforce agility, and improving employee engagement, supporting sustained growth and organizational resilience.
The Company does not expect this amendment to have an impact on its operations or Standalone financial statements.
